title: Walter McDaniel
description: Darth Vader's psychic stranglehold ("I find your lack of faith disturbing") was so popular that it became a running gag (choke?) in the STAR WARS saga. Illustrator Walter McDaniel is originally from St. Thomas, Virgin Islands, and has worked in advertising since the age of 16. McDaniel trained with the likes of Gil Ashbey, Michael Davis, Rich Buckler and Neal Adams. He currently works for Marvel Comics, Milestone, Image Comics - and is a founding member of the soon to be world-renowned Visage Studios.
